title: Setup Compose Repo MCP Server
description: Setup repo mcp server for the monorepo according to https://developers.openai.com/codex/mcp/. The server should provide MCP tools for repo management operations like search, ticket management, file operations, etc. Use the existing Go server as a base and add MCP endpoints.
summary: Updated Codex MCP bootstrap to merge generated mcp_servers entries into existing ~/.codex/config.toml without removing user settings, added cwd + absolute repo paths, refreshed the live home config, and extended the existing devcontainer bootstrap test to cover preserving Codex user settings.
